verdict.rationale: Meilisearch documents self-hosting as a single binary on any Linux, macOS, or Windows machine, on bare metal, Docker, or Kubernetes, so users can place their data wherever they choose. For the managed Cloud, region choice is only implied by a community user who found the closest instance was Singapore and wished for an Australian one. missing for 10: first-party documentation of Cloud region selection and a region list, explicit data-residency or compliance guarantees, and broader region coverage (e.g. Australia).
